instruction.text: Mahans Mutter berichtet über ihren Arbeitsplatz. Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: Last year, I started to work from home. Before that, I worked in an office. I'm really happy about changing my place of work and there are many reasons why. First, I don't need to commute to work any more. In the past, I had to take the bus to work for an hour. Currently, I only have to walk a few steps from my bedroom to my desk. Consequently, I have more time to sleep now. Secondly, I don't have to change my clothes and wear uncomfortable clothes at work. You are more likely to find me in my jumper and sweatpants than in a suit when I'm at work. Moreover, I can choose to work at my desk, my dining table or on my couch when I work from home. I didn't have this freedom at my old office job.

instruction.text: Mahans Mutter berichtet über ihren Arbeitsplatz. Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to work overtime</voice> bedeutet Überstunden leisten

atoms.text: However, working from home also has its disadvantages. I miss seeing my colleagues regularly at work. If I still worked in the office, I would talk to my colleagues every day. Since I work from home, I'm alone during my working hours, and I'm not a fan of it. In addition, it got more difficult for me to separate my free time from my work time, as they happen in the same place. When I worked at the office, I left all tasks related to work in the office. Now, I tend to work overtime because all my emails and files are right next to me. I have a look at them sometimes, although it's past my working time. Consequently, every employee has to choose carefully if they want to work from home. Although I enjoy it, someone else might not.
